description: This file defines the TableRenderer class responsible for rendering tables in a PDF document using the PdfSharp and MigraDoc libraries. It handles the layout, borders, cell content, header processing, and merging logic for table rendering.

classes.name: TableRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class for converting a MigraDoc Table object into a visual representation in a PDF document, handling layout, borders, cell content, and header/footer operations.

methods.name: InitialLayoutInfo
methods.description: Returns the initial layout information for the table, including keep-together settings and margins.

methods.name: InitRendering
methods.description: Initializes rendering parameters based on format info and prepares internal state.

methods.name: RenderHeaderRows
methods.description: Renders the header rows of the table, including merged headers.

methods.name: RenderCell
methods.description: Handles rendering of a single cell, including its shading, content, and borders.

methods.name: EqualizeRoundedCornerBorders
methods.description: Ensures border consistency for cells with rounded corners by copying border styles.

methods.name: RenderShading
methods.description: Renders the shading (background) for a cell.

methods.name: RenderBorders
methods.description: Renders the borders, including handling rounded corners and diagonal borders.

methods.name: RenderDiagonalBorders
methods.description: Renders diagonal borders within a cell.

methods.name: RenderContent
methods.description: Renders the cell's content inside its rectangle.

methods.name: GetInnerRect
methods.description: Calculates the inner rectangle for a cell, considering borders and merging.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Performs the overall rendering of the table.

methods.name: InitFormat
methods.description: Initializes formatting data structures for the table rendering process.

methods.name: FormatCells
methods.description: Measures and formats all cells in the table.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates layout, breaks, and pagination for the table based on the available area.

methods.name: UpdateThisPagesBookmarks
methods.description: Updates bookmarks for table rows on the current page.

methods.name: FinishLayoutInfo
methods.description: Finalizes layout info after measuring.

methods.name: LeftBorderOffset
methods.description: Caches and computes the offset for the left border.

methods.name: CalcStartingHeight
methods.description: Calculates the starting height for rendering, considering headers.

methods.name: CalcLastHeaderColumn
methods.description: Determines last header column for repeating header rows.

methods.name: CalcLastHeaderRow
methods.description: Determines last header row for repeating headers.

methods.name: CreateConnectedRows
methods.description: Computes the connection map for rows with merged cells.

methods.name: CreateConnectedColumns
methods.description: Computes the connection map for columns with merged cells.

methods.name: CreateBottomBorderMap
methods.description: Builds a map of bottom border positions for rows.

methods.name: CalcMaxTopBorderWidth
methods.description: Calculates the maximum width of top borders for a row.

methods.name: CreateNextBottomBorderPosition
methods.description: Determines the next position of the bottom border in the table.

methods.name: CalcBottomBorderWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of a bottom border for a cell.

methods.name: GetMinMergedCell
methods.description: Finds the cell with the minimal merge extent that ends in a specified row.

methods.name: CalcLastConnectedRow
methods.description: Returns the last row connected downward from a given row (cached).

methods.name: CalcLastConnectedRowDirect
methods.description: Computes directly the last row connected downward from a given row.

methods.name: CalcLastConnectedColumn
methods.description: Returns the last column connected horizontally from a given column.
